title: Same-day dock cutoff
body: Warren dock GL-14 accepts same-day freight until 14:30 America/New_York.

title: Generator lane
body: Generator shipments stage in lane B and leave on route GL-14.

title: Routine invoice post
body: Posting account.move with action_post is a routine production write.

title: Vendor mail front door
body: Vendor threads are claimed, classified, and drafted. They are not auto-sent.

title: Tuesday cycle count
body: Cycle counts for small parts run Tuesday at 06:00 before the dock opens.

title: Carrier window
body: The afternoon carrier window closes at 16:00. Missed freight rolls to the next route.
